en.answer: In the proposed scenario, the ATK and DEF increase is changed to a decrease, but even in that case, the part of the effect that reduces all battle damage the opponent takes to 0 is applied normally.
en.question: While <<4695>> is active, if the effect of <<11710>> that increases ATK and DEF is activated, is the battle damage the opponent takes reduced to 0?
